_comment: Declares that this record's stored text CANNOT be re-derived from its stored original. Checked and falsification-tested by scripts/derive_text.py.
not_derivable_reason: capture_history records the text as 'Extracted from the UNOOSA 2021 publication of the Guidelines (reproducing A/74/20 annex II) via web-fetch PDF text extraction' (a6ff1dea13fa...), with the official publication PDF (9dbdf01acc33...) stored afterwards as a byte-exact anchor upgrade. Same pattern as the Luxembourg record: the anchor was strengthened, which is right, and the consequence is that the text is no longer derivable from what is stored beside it.
_remedy: Re-deriving would require storing the ORIGINAL capture artefact alongside the upgraded anchor. That is an ingest decision, not a recipe problem.
